# Continuous Agent Loop

This is the canonical loop skill. It picks the loop, stacks the gates, and recovers a stalled loop. The full mechanics of each loop live in `autonomous-loops`; goal definition and the runaway review (decidable goal, boundaries, independent judge, retry cap) live in `loop-design-check`. Run `loop-design-check` before starting any loop that runs unattended.

## Loop Selection Flow

```text
Start
  |
  +-- Need strict CI/PR control? -> yes -> continuous-pr
  |
  +-- Need RFC decomposition? -> yes -> rfc-dag
  |
  +-- Need exploratory parallel generation? -> yes -> infinite
  |
  +-- default -> sequential
```

Where each branch is documented in `autonomous-loops`:

| Branch | Pattern |
|---|---|
| `continuous-pr` | 4. Continuous Claude PR Loop |
| `rfc-dag` | 6. Ralphinho / RFC-Driven DAG Orchestration (`ralphinho-rfc-pipeline`) |
| `infinite` | 3. Infinite Agentic Loop |
| `sequential` | 1. Sequential Pipeline, with 5. De-Sloppify as the add-on |

## Combined Pattern

Recommended production stack:
1. RFC decomposition (`ralphinho-rfc-pipeline`)
2. quality gates (`plankton-code-quality` + `/quality-gate`)
3. eval loop (`eval-harness`)
4. session persistence (`nanoclaw-repl`)

## Failure Modes

- loop churn without measurable progress
- repeated retries with same root cause
- merge queue stalls
- cost drift from unbounded escalation

## Recovery

- freeze loop
- run `/harness-audit`
- reduce scope to failing unit
- replay with explicit acceptance criteria
